title: While Guthix Sleeps
start: Talk to Radimus Erkle in the Legends' Guild, which is located in the north-east of Ardougne.
prereq_other: Ability to enter the Warriors' Guild

requirements.t: Be eligible for entry to the Warriors' Guild (the sum of your Attack and Strength must be at or above 130, 99 Attack or 99 Strength)

items.t: Three air runes, an earth rune, a fire rune, a water rune, a mind rune, a law rune, and a death rune
Any logs (except acadia or eternal magic)
A charcoal and a papyrus (both may easily be obtained during the quest)
Mort myre fungus (can be obtained during the quest)
Equipment to enter the Black Knights' Fortress
Runes to cast the NPC Contact spell four times (8 air runes, 4 astral runes, and 4 cosmic runes)
Runes for any charge orb spell (30 runes of a chosen element and three cosmic runes)
Equipment for two different attack styles or Necromancy equipment
Either a snapdragon seed or 100 coins to buy one from Thaerisk

recommended.t: Completion of Nature Spirit for access to druid pouch or ouroboros pouch; alternatively, bring the required ingredients for the statue
Activated Burthorpe, Canifis, Edgeville, Falador, Karamja, Oo'glog, Port Sarim, Seers' Village, Taverley, Varrock, Ardougne and Yanille lodestone
A dramen or lunar staff, unless you have completed A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift
A cape of legends for instant teleport to the Legends' Guild
Multiple Falador teletabs or ring of respawn for continual return to Falador
Runes to cast the NPC Contact spell three additional times (6 air runes, 3 astral runes, and 3 cosmic runes)
A set of elite black armour or Black Knight captain's armour to save time
Otherwise, obtainable during the quest requiring you to kill guards until you collect each piece

Black Knight captain's armour is obtained early into the The Death of Chivalry quest by searching a suit of armour shortly after accepting the quest (a cosmetic override of the armour can be unlocked using the Skull of Remembrance after the quest)
Ingredients for a Guthix balance potion (clean harralander, red spiders' eggs, garlic, and silver dust) may be needed for the statue.

kills.t: 2 Tormented demons (level 119; your stats are boosted extremely high during the fight)

rewards.t: 4 × 100,000 experience from Idria, in any skill that is at least 65.
100 magic logs, 100 coal, 100 fire runes, and 100 death runes; all items are in their un-noted form.
A strange key teeth and a strange key loop
Opportunity to kill tormented demons for dragon metal pieces, dragon claw and dragon limbs.
A set of elite black armour
A set of Dagon'hai robe armour
Access to the Black Knights' Catacombs.
The Balance Elemental can be faced in Dominion Tower.
Opportunity to buy blast fusion hammers from the Blast Furnace Foreman.

steps.t: Talk to Radimus Erkle in the Legends' Guild (fairy ring BLR). [Chat: 4 Yes, I'm interested, where do I report? › Accept]
In Taverley, talk to Ivy Sophista in the house west of the summoning obelisk. [Chat: 1 Ask about 'While Guthix Sleeps'. › 4 Our friend in common places great faith in totems.]
Go upstairs and talk to Thaerisk Cemphier. Kill both assassins that appear.
Talk to Thaerisk again. [Chat: 1 What efforts are you making against Lucien? › 2 What are our options? › 2 I know about the 'Fist of Guthix'. › 3 What do you need me to do? › 4 Okay, thanks.]

Talk to Reldo in Varrock Palace library and "Talk about Lucien and Movario" [Chat: ? Talk about Lucien and Movario. › 1 What can you tell me about Movario? › 2 What does Movario do? › 3 Where does Movario live? › 4 Okay, thanks.]

sub.t: If Desperate Times is completed, you need to choose one more chat option before proceed the aforementioned quest dialogue. [Chat: 2 [Talk to Reldo.]]

steps.t: Talk to the Hunting expert in Feldip Hunter area and ask about tracking down a person. [Chat: ? A creature to help track down a person. › 2 How can I catch a wild broav? › 3 What do I do once I've caught a broav? › 4 Okay, thanks.] She is north of Oo'glog lodestone, or south-west of fairy ring AKS. After the conversation she will give you a mort myre fungus.
Go west and trap pit (which builds a pitfall trap) at the square trap pit (uses one set of logs), then use your mort myre fungus on the built trap.
Dismantle the collapsed trap to obtain an unconscious broav.
Talk to the Hunting expert again about tracking a person. [Chat: ? A creature to help track down a person.]

Head to the west of Fight Arena and into the laundry room two houses north of the pub. (Kandarin monastery Teleport then run south, or Watchtower Teleport and run north, or use the Fairy ring code DJP and run south are quick ways to get there.)
With your ring of charos (a) equipped, talk to the Khazard launderer to obtain dirty laundry. [Chat: 2 Do you know someone called Movario? › 2 (Charm) Tell me all you know about Movario.]

sub.t: If you brought coins instead, take them out of your coin pouch and use them on the launderer. [Chat: 2 No, I need information. Do you know someone called Movario? › 1 Offer five thousand coins for information on Movario.]

steps.t: Go to the Khazard Battleground north-west (north of Tree Gnome Village and across the bridges).
Climb-over the crumbled wall inside the north-westernmost building.
Drop your Broav in the room with the broken table then use the dirty laundry on him.
Search the broken table to reveal a trapdoor, then go down.
Pick-up your Broav.
Go through the door, and follow the path to the north, then climb-down the stairs.
Search the old battered door and find the correct rune to use on it. After you enter the correct rune, you'll hear a click.
Search the door again (boost your Thieving level if needed), and you will find a trap to disarm. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'm an awesome thief, I'll disable it easily!]
Go through the old battered door.
Search the painting on the east wall [Chat: 1 Yes, I'll flip the catch and see what happens.].
Choose the Search option on the bookcases until you receive the chat response RSFont | CLICK! | colour=#FFF | bg=#777 .
Follow the wire that faintly glows to the next bookshelf. (for those with colourblindness, zoom the camera in to see the wire slightly pulsate)

sub.t: Search that bookshelf.
Repeat, searching each bookshelf until the electricity on the gate disappears.

steps.t: Open the gate and search the spiral staircase to disarm the trap, then climb-up.
Search the desk to obtain Movario's notes (volume 1)

sub.t: Read the notes.

steps.t: Pick-up the waste-paper basket.

sub.t: With Movario's notes in your backpack, search the basket.

steps.t: Search the bookcase to the west of the waste-paper basket.

sub.t: Use the ruby key on the bookcase.
Climb-up the stairs just north of you.

steps.t: Search the bed.

sub.t: Use the ruby key on the bed chest.
Search the bed chest to disarm the traps [Chat: 1 Yes, I'll attempt it.] You may need to attempt again until you disarm the trap.
Use the ruby key on the chest. Open and search the chest to obtain a strange key loop, strange key teeth, and Movario's notes (volume 2). Read these notes too.

steps.t: Climb back down twice to the wire room and cross-over the broken wall, then search the drawers.

Look-at the thermometer. Note down the number it says. Check your current character's weight in your equipment interface. You must equalise both numbers. If you weigh more than the number: subtract the number from the thermometer from your character's weight to get the result number. For example: if the thermometer says 20 and you weigh 30kg , you would need 10kg . If you weigh less than the number: subtract your character's weight from the number from to get the result number.

sub.t: Pick up your Broav if you haven't already, otherwise it will mess with the numbers.

steps.t: On the floor of this room is a Pile of weights. Take weights equalling the result number you got. If you have been following the guide, you will need to take two 2kg weights, as Movario's notes and the key parts weigh 4kg collectively. CAUTION: You will not be able to recover any items dropped in this room.

Climb back up the spiral staircase. If you weigh more than the number: use all the weights on the statue just north of you, then open the door just east. If you weigh less than the number: keep the weights in your inventory and open the door east of the statue.
Head east through the door and up the ladder to leave the hideout.
Return to Thaerisk Cemphier in Taverley with the items obtained in Movario's base. [Chat: 2 What should I do now? › 5 Sorry, I have to go.]
Head to the building in McGrubor's Wood (Seers' Village lodestone or fairy ring ALS), and a cutscene will start. Kill all the mercenaries.
Search the dead mercenaries and talk to the wounded Guardian of Armadyl.
Go upstairs in the Seers' Village pub and talk to Idria. [Chat: 1 Do you know where Lucien is? › 3 How can I get to Lucien?]
Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien in the Falador Park. [Chat: 1 While Guthix Sleeps.] or [Chat: 2] if the Slug Menace hasn't been completed.
Go to the White Knights' Castle.
In the eastern room on the floor 1, talk to Akrisae. [Chat: 3 How can I get to Draynor? › 1 Yes, please!]
At Draynor Village, use the teleorb on the shady stranger wearing white robes and near the shore. This may take several attempts.
Talk to Akrisae in the White Knight's Castle. Cutscene plays.
If you don't have a snapdragon seed for the next step, buy one from Thaerisk. [Chat: 2 Could you help me get a snapdragon seed? › 1 Yes.]
Talk to Thaerisk to teleport to Port Sarim. [Chat: 3 Can you teleport me to Port Sarim, please?]

steps.sec: Super truth serum and recruiting the Heroes
steps.t: Talk to Betty in the Port Sarim magic shop for truth serum and pink dye. [Chat: 1 Talk to Betty about While Guthix Sleeps. › 1 Yes, please can I have a standard truth serum? › 1 Yes, please!] (If The Hand In The Sand quest is completed [Chat: 2 Talk to Betty about While Guthix Sleeps. › 1 Yes, please can I have a standard truth serum? › 1 Yes, please!])

steps.sec: Super truth serum and recruiting the Heroes
steps.t: If the snapdragon seed isn't already on the counter, talk to her again until she places the seed on the counter.

steps.sec: Super truth serum and recruiting the Heroes
steps.t: Use the pink dye on your lantern lens.

steps.sec: Super truth serum and recruiting the Heroes
steps.t: Stand just inside the doorway, use the lens with the counter and take the enriched snapdragon seed by searching the counter.

steps.sec: Super truth serum and recruiting the Heroes
steps.t: If not already, switch to the Lunar spellbook.

steps.sec: Super truth serum and recruiting the Heroes
steps.t: Using the most western staircase in White Knight Castle, head to the top of the castle and plant the seed in the herb patch.

steps.sec: Super truth serum and recruiting the Heroes
steps.t: Go back downstairs and talk to Thaerisk on the ground floor of the eastern part of the castle. [Chat: 1 I've planted the enriched snapdragon seed.]

steps.sec: Super truth serum and recruiting the Heroes
steps.t: Cast NPC Contact to talk to the following people:

sub.t: Turael [Chat: 1 I need to talk to you about Lucien.]
Duradel [Chat: 1 I need to talk to you about Lucien.]
Mazchna [Chat: 1 I need to talk to you about Lucien.]

steps.sec: Super truth serum and recruiting the Heroes
steps.t: Talk to Hazelmere upstairs in the hut east of Yanille near fairy ring CLS.
Pick the enriched snapdragon (top of west tower at White Knights' Castle) and mix it into your truth serum for a super truth serum.
Head back to the room with Thaerisk and the others.
Open and search the drawers to find charcoal and papyrus.

Go into the cell and use the serum on the shady stranger. [Chat: ~] The correct chat option varies from player to player. Exhaust chat options until you reach the correct one so that the stranger drinks the serum.
Talk to Idria (she is now in this same room).
Cast NPC Contact to talk to Cyrisus. [Chat: 1 I need to talk to you about Lucien.]
Head to the Warriors' Guild and talk to the following:

sub.t: Ghommal just outside
Harrallak Menarous in the main lobby [Chat: 1 I need to talk to you about Lucien!]
Sloane upstairs [Chat: 1 Recruit Sloane for the hero party.]

steps.t: Return to the White Knights' Castle and speak to Idria, then Akrisae.

WARNING, BEFORE KILLING ANY ELITE BLACK KNIGHTS DISABLE AOE SPELLS, If you are doing this on a ironman killing two at once will cause a duplicate piece to drop. The only way around this is farm elite black knights to get the piece you will be missing.
Switch back to the standard spellbook.
You will need 11 free inventory slots to proceed.
Equip your disguise and head inside Black Knights' Fortress with all the items above or use the skull of remembrance to teleport to the ritual chamber, and make your way down to the floor 1.
Climb down the ladder in the south-west corner.
Along the east wall, right-click search the floor tile. Cast your charge orb spell on the floor tile.
Climb-down the trapdoor.

Kill Elite Black Knights to obtain a helmet, platebody and platelegs if you don't have a set already. The three pieces of armour are guaranteed to drop until 3 pieces are received. Do not use multi-target abilities as killing two Elite Black Knights at once will cause them both to drop the same piece, with both counting toward the first 3 pieces received. Equip the full set to remove their aggression.
Head north by jumping across the broken bridge, go east, and climb up the wall.
Jump over the barricade and walk north-west until you reach a fork in the path, then head east.
Talk to Silif in the northmost cell. [Chat: 1 Silif, it's me, [Name]. Are you okay? › 2 I want to get you out of here. Any suggestions? › 3 I'll be back to try to get you out.]
Go back west and enter the northern centre Solid black door.
Search all desks and wardrobes in the room for:

sub.t: Another set of elite black armour
Full set of Dagon'hai robes
Restore potion (4) (Do not drink the restore potion)
Strange teleorb
Lobster (Do not eat the lobster)
If you accidentally eat the lobster, any kind of cooked food will work as well.

steps.t: Right-click search the key rack on the northern wall (a few tiles east of the wardrobe) for a Cell key.
Enter Silif's cell. Use the piece of food on Silif, then the potion. [Chat: 2 Do you have a plan?]
Give Silif a set of elite black armour (dismiss your familiar if you have one).
Return to the northern room. Walk to the map board on the southern wall then talk to Silif.
Plant the teleorb on Dark Squall, who is located in the east of the room, then escape back to Falador.
Talk to Akrisae. [Chat: 1 What would this orb look like? › 2 How will I be able to get to Lucien's base? › 3 Okay, thanks.]
Wear your Dagon'hai robes and enter the nearby jail cell.

Climb up the ladder in the north-eastern corner, stand in the stone circle in the middle of the room, and right-click activate the strange teleorb. (Note: Activation will fail if the required runes are in a pouch.)
p: The ice wall and the ledge.

steps.t: Follow the north-eastern path towards the chapel and climb-up the ice wall. There is a stick in the ice wall to indicate where to climb.
Jump-to the ledge on the chapel into the Wilderness.
Walk east to activate a cutscene.
Return to Falador after the cutscene.
Talk to Idria.

sub.t: If she won't talk about Movario and instead keeps saying to investigate Lucien's camp, then unfortunately the game glitched and you must go back and rewatch the cutscene. Remember to bring the strange teleorb, a law rune, and a death rune. A good indicator that the cutscene registered is to check for the "You have unlocked a new music track: The Evil Within" game message.

steps.t: Go to the Tears of Guthix cavern.

Equip your Dagon'hai robes and talk to Movario North. [Chat: 3 I am Surok, Lucien has sent me to check on your progress. › 1 I could go down to the bottom first, to make sure it's safe! › 3 I shall return.]
With a sapphire lantern lit, right-click travel into cavern with a light creature.
Search the northernmost skeleton for a silver sickle (b) and 6 druid pouch charges.

sub.t: If you have an Ouroboros pouch or brought two druid pouch charges of your own, you can drop the silver sickle to save inventory space.

steps.t: Search the rocks [Chat: 1 Yes] in the north-eastern corner. Then search on the brazier that appears, choosing the chisel option to receive a fire orb.
Repeat on the north-west rock for the earth orb.
Repeat for the standing lit braziers for air and water orbs in the south-western and south-eastern corners.
Head further south to reach three skull cavities on the southern wall. Examine each recessed block and use the respective orb on the block.
Climb up the wall twice and use the water orb on the recessed block.
Jump down the same way you came up. For each of the three lower skulls, enter its nose cavity.

sub.t: Dismiss any followers and empty both your main and off-hand slots before entering the cavities.

steps.t: Crawl along the tunnel in each cavity to its end. Examine the door there and insert the respective element key into the door lock. Crawl back through the tunnel and exit the skull.
Climb up the walls to the upper skull. Use the fire key on the skull's recessed block, then search the stone cube in front of the skull.
Climb-through the cave opening to enter the Guthixian temple.
You will now need at least two free backpack spaces, though more can make it quicker to proceed. Ensure that you have also deactivated any sign of the porter effects.
There are eight statues in this temple. Each, when examined, will reveal what type of potion must be "made" at that statue.

Use your druid pouches on the druid spirits. Each will drop required ingredients for the statues once - if these are lost (e.g. by dropping and letting them timeout), you will have to get replacements yourself. Grace of the elves will send items to the bank so unequip it or disable its porter functionality.
Do not let your druid pouch empty completely or it disappears! You need 3 open inventory slots to add 3 flowers into the druid pouch.

sub.t: Use the Bloom spell on your silver sickle (b) while standing on or close to the dead vine to grow some vine flower to recharge your druid pouch.

steps.t: Use the herbs and the secondary ingredients on the various statues referencing the table below. Not all keywords will be on statues.

sub.t: If you have an ouroboros pouch, you do not need to worry about the druid pouch losing charges. However, you must carry a druid pouch in the backpack to "use" it on the spirits, though it will never deplete.

If you need to refill your druid pouch, right-click bloom with your silver sickle near dead vines to get flowers. These can be used to refill the druid pouch. If you received a mort myre fungus from the druids, use it with the correct statue or drop it for a moment before filling the druid pouch else you will lose it!

steps.t: Use the dolmens you receive from the statues on the Stone Table in the middle of the temple. It will open the huge door in front of it.

Make whatever arrangements necessary to battle the level 117 Balance Elemental that can use all three combat styles, and lowers your combat stats (except for Necromancy). You can leave the area to get supplies, but always bring your lit sapphire lantern. Don't forget to bring at least two combat styles for the tormented demon fight, unless using Necromancy. The Balance Elemental drains combat stats during the fight, so be sure to bring at least one full super restore.
p: Thaerisk, Idria, and Akrisae discussing plans
The druid attempting to administer the truth serum to the stranger
The ladder leading down to the Black Knight basement
The tile on which you need to cast Charge Orb. Better not forget your runes and the standard spellbook!
Remember to bring a death and law rune!

steps.t: Proceed down the corridor and enter a large chamber.
Once ready, search the mysterious stone [Chat: 1 Yes, I need to investigate this, even if it kills me!] and kill the Balance Elemental that appears. See the strategy guide here.
Search the mysterious stone again for a cutscene. Doing so boosts all your combat stats to level 255 except Prayer.
p: Movario searches for the Stone of Jas.

steps.t: Continue dialogue with Movario [Chat: 1 What are you going to do with the Stone of Jas? › 2 What is the Stone of Jas? › 3 You can't let Lucien get the Stone of Jas! › 4 What if someone should stand in your way?], then with Lucien. [Chat: 1 What are you going to do with the Stone of Jas? › 2 Why is the Stone of Jas so important to you? › 3 Do you really hope to follow in the footsteps of Zamorak?]
Kill the two Tormented demons, switching between your two combat styles.
p: A player touches the Stone of Jas, receiving temporary power.
The player and several Guardians of Armadyl battling Lucien's "pets".

steps.t: Talk to Idria to have her teleport you to Falador. [Chat: 1 Yes, a teleport out of here would be good.]
Continue dialogue with Idria in Falador.
Quest complete!
Optional: after using of all four of Idria's 100,000 exp boosts, talk to her again to view the "Elsewhere..." epilogue.
p: A dragonkin contemplating return to Gielinor during the epilogue.
Where your Broav leads you to.
A player uses a rose tinted lens on the snapdragon seed
A player harvests the enriched snapdragon from the farming patch on the top of the castle.
When you open up the Lunar spell NPC Contact, Cyrisus is still there, but greyed out. If you choose him, the chat box says "You take a moment of silence in honour of your fallen brethren, Cyrisus.…
Two statues of Turael and Duradel at the entrance of the Slayer Tower.
Two memorial statues of Ghommal and Sloane now flank the entrance to the Warriors' Guild.
All of the memorial statues of the fallen heroes line the sides of the bridge.
